**L-cysteine** is an amino acid with early, limited evidence suggesting it may reduce certain alcohol hangover symptoms—such as nausea, headache, stress, and anxiety—by helping neutralize acetaldehyde, a toxic byproduct of alcohol metabolism. However, evidence is still preliminary and comes with methodological caveats, so ` [Highlight start] it is not a proven hangover cure [Highlight end] `.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXTThW1JFx0zZAOPCYXWgqPbabgrySHDl8wUZR9V76oPv88cz1qlchVTvbO0JzDaIQM9-z88sdBGZiHpO-g_ua8OWLtnhj_Aj5Bd_WKqWQqp6srHB-cKNMwjo_VJBIuFg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF113Mp-onivrG1yURAAOv2lzQxt8cuKUilHtv6Fxbz4X8FrBcSjR7ubYO5_5XPSiWwmoaMKcOAao5_nFrNbvOFdwmht5ZpcX2Ru2j1wVu9Cs2d7fqYp5MnJ4j1g_YtEHX8yWs5tWz12Y7b7F35PzyY3cFSOi-pYtwZu8xbA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF18P7W6ZOfssBaSrWNIHRD_4owywu3h7nb7wZ92nbhao8TKiXSXdN9JtyqiIHDChR0HbJpKpBtgt_P9Sr5hqEtKfJTBTZGJ-JerXjWBRePS3ZjXXCyPu2rV2Pisw85GyDURAN8MLEHbdgQbK-XCtGBKNA1jDTPeNBolOc9FJkL5KOVWJn8GiBzLo)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXMTI6cpyLulXZe8Ffpzsc9QTmHDE57QhRBPuvcsbzsa9zxG5XU0olLhskmTfMhz7QMt97lJucfddusnIYWrAa7aRtOjDi_1fpmm-CN4JJKSdFMFnl40fecfWjAeh9AXIySF1VKS3s6nVEKS0jXGqok8H88qYmyJw)

#### What Research Shows

- **Symptom relief:** In a small, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial reported on [PubMed](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXTThW1JFx0zZAOPCYXWgqPbabgrySHDl8wUZR9V76oPv88cz1qlchVTvbO0JzDaIQM9-z88sdBGZiHpO-g_ua8OWLtnhj_Aj5Bd_WKqWQqp6srHB-cKNMwjo_VJBIuFg) , L-cysteine administration was associated with lower self-rated hangover severity, nausea, headache, stress, and anxiety.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStgEBxCJF152T7paHfjw7xU7FK2s_ZgM4GH21pv3pR_l2qT33qrQGG_WAcG_P4y9OitIaotR5AupW4Ulp9kZN5OxESNrrNe_NM-dXBQV_Umyi8UceFD-G0bZNxpt_VAMUjZB-uIhPOLe8_8OBwYyJDNZC8P9NyhnRnugaJxdz27wIike-VV3U1YRW8PuXhF0vn_NMcHpf_ilvBHf71HqFrPvbxkAvJH2jnJBLXdYVPSDkJd1aDnBKBw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXTThW1JFx0zZAOPCYXWgqPbabgrySHDl8wUZR9V76oPv88cz1qlchVTvbO0JzDaIQM9-z88sdBGZiHpO-g_ua8OWLtnhj_Aj5Bd_WKqWQqp6srHB-cKNMwjo_VJBIuFg)
- **How it may work:** Researchers propose L-cysteine binds or helps clear acetaldehyde and supports liver antioxidant defenses (such as glutathione pathways). Studies on related compounds like N-acetylcysteine (NAC) have also been explored for hangover and oxidative stress effects.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXLlw9dOwcv1gwda-I80AwTgLeq3dT70uR9E2pHm8gYqvyBpvj_B4YBFcNffFChKSfMF0Q6EtQkdri1w9eVHM_tVSKkY_XdDsUqSUF695Dh18zkaFTEJMUsSSdkSt7nL2Jr7G65T8eyyw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF113Mp-onivrG1yURAAOv2lzQxt8cuKUilHtv6Fxbz4X8FrBcSjR7ubYO5_5XPSiWwmoaMKcOAao5_nFrNbvOFdwmht5ZpcX2Ru2j1wVu9Cs2d7fqYp5MnJ4j1g_YtEHX8yWs5tWz12Y7b7F35PzyY3cFSOi-pYtwZu8xbA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF18P7W6ZOfssBaSrWNIHRD_4owywu3h7nb7wZ92nbhao8TKiXSXdN9JtyqiIHDChR0HbJpKpBtgt_P9Sr5hqEtKfJTBTZGJ-JerXjWBRePS3ZjXXCyPu2rV2Pisw85GyDURAN8MLEHbdgQbK-XCtGBKNA1jDTPeNBolOc9FJkL5KOVWJn8GiBzLo)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXL2ui_OiITSlNPHcYss_S2rp0ACT9NDXJ_g-43g6oOp-jyHGPWZLUpTQ9t3Ug3bqmpNeeQ_j_nFNUc5ucusdmTQ4Ad62Iz_DL1zGl2lZ9KFyl7xytuXF8kRqKQO-Vn0QZiO3IK4vSxH0)
- **Limitations:** The key human hangover study had a small sample size (19 men in the hangover arm), and an independent commentary in [Alcohol and Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXMTI6cpyLulXZe8Ffpzsc9QTmHDE57QhRBPuvcsbzsa9zxG5XU0olLhskmTfMhz7QMt97lJucfddusnIYWrAa7aRtOjDi_1fpmm-CN4JJKSdFMFnl40fecfWjAeh9AXIySF1VKS3s6nVEKS0jXGqok8H88qYmyJw) noted limitations in how treatment-versus-placebo comparisons were presented and analyzed. Larger, independent trials are still needed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXMTI6cpyLulXZe8Ffpzsc9QTmHDE57QhRBPuvcsbzsa9zxG5XU0olLhskmTfMhz7QMt97lJucfddusnIYWrAa7aRtOjDi_1fpmm-CN4JJKSdFMFnl40fecfWjAeh9AXIySF1VKS3s6nVEKS0jXGqok8H88qYmyJw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXTThW1JFx0zZAOPCYXWgqPbabgrySHDl8wUZR9V76oPv88cz1qlchVTvbO0JzDaIQM9-z88sdBGZiHpO-g_ua8OWLtnhj_Aj5Bd_WKqWQqp6srHB-cKNMwjo_VJBIuFg)

#### Practical Context & Safety

- **No substitute for basics:** Hydration, rest, food, and pacing or limiting alcohol intake remain the most reliable ways to prevent or manage a hangover.
